items.title: The Suns are one financial mistake away from a superteam
items.summary: The vibes in Phoenix are good, and the way the organization has navigated its cap sheet to field a competitive team, despite the disadvantages of limited controllable draft capital and $23.2 million in dead cap, deserves applause. Why? Look at the Milwaukee Bucks.I’ve made this case before, and we’ve continued to watch it play out. The Bucks essentially became the Phoenix Suns of the Eastern Conference. Granted, they won a championship, so many of the aggressive decisions they made can be justified. But they also leveraged a significant portion of their future in an effort to remain competitive, and eventually the bill came due.They sent out multiple draft picks to acquire Jrue Holiday, then gave up even more to land Damian Lillard. Later, much like the Suns did with Bradley Beal, they waived and stretched Lillard’s contract. Now look at where they are. They’ve finally committed to…
